description: The main window on Windows and Linux, where the system gives it no frame (tauri.windows.conf.json, tauri.linux.conf.json; task TC2 of agent-threads.md): the three window controls that the client draws. The client sends each command for its own window. The command of Tauri takes the label of a window, so a script of the main web view could also minimise, maximise or close a different window of the application; it can already close a device web view (desktop.json), so this gives it no new reach that matters. Moving the window by its top strip is in main.json.
